title: SarnautCore faction
description: A faction and its hostility relations. Factions are global resources with no zone. Until this document type existed a mob's faction was an href pointing at nothing this project could read, so nothing declared that Wild is attackable and hostile to players while League is not (combat.md rule 5.2.5).

player_faction.description: True when a player character can belong to this faction.

attackable.description: Whether members of this faction may be targeted by a hostile ability at all. A faction can be hostile and unattackable (a quest giver that will not fight) or attackable and neutral (wildlife that fights back only when struck).

default_stance.description: The stance towards any faction with no explicit relation below. Making this required means a missing relation is a decision rather than an accident.

relations.description: Explicit stances towards named factions. Relations are directed: A hostile to B does not imply B hostile to A.

faction.description: The canonical id of the other faction.

stance.description: hostile: may be attacked on sight and attacks on sight. neutral: neither attacks first. friendly: cannot be attacked by this faction and assists it.
